verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Azure CLI, IaC tools (Bicep/ARM/Terraform), RBAC, managed identities, and cost management, but contains no documentation of serverless/scheduled automation services (e.g., Azure Functions timers, Logic Apps, Azure Automation runbooks) that would let an AI-native user set up autonomous background automations. The only mention of Azure Functions is a negative community complaint about log access pain, not a description of the automation capability itself, so there is no first-party claim to judge as delivered or disputed.
